widget_configuration.textContent:
Want the best choice of fancy dress costumes in Galway? Then check out PartyWorld. We have 1000's of costumes at great prices, fast 24-hour delivery. Whether you are planning a rocking 60’s party, stage show, kids fancy dress party or the mother of all Hen parties you won’t be disappointed.

Buy online - We have a great 24-hour delivery service as standard.

 From toddlers to teens, adults and plus sizes, we have something for everyone. Are you looking for a fun costume to make everyone laugh? It doesn’t get much funnier than our hilarious Novelty Costumes, or perhaps cute and cuddly with our Big Baby Costume. We have loads of sexy costumes and 60s and 70s costumes, as well as film, TV and games characters. Whatever you are looking for we’re sure you’ll have fun looking at PartyWorld.

widget_configuration.htmlCode:
Party Decorations and Fancy Dress Costumes

Welcome to PartyWorld - Ireland's favourite party store. We have a wide variety of costumes, accessories and party supplies which are suitable for every party occasion!

Browse our large selection of Halloween Costumes, Accessories, Kids Costumes and more. Here at PartyWorld, we believe adults and children should never need an excuse to dress up and we have lots of different outfits here for you to tryout.

Are you planning a Hen Party? Then why not tryout our Hen Party Accessories and fancy dress outfits that are guaranteed to ensure you have a great time.

PartyWorld offers next working day delivery in Ireland for all orders placed before 3:30 pm. Shop online.
